title: Three men charged with domestic violence-related murders after three women killed in separate incidents in NSW
summary_full: A Bondi Beach woman in her 90s, a 23-year-old in Wagga Wagga and a woman in her 70s in Mole River died within hours of each other on Saturday Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updatesGet our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastThree men have been accused of domestic violence-related murders after the deaths of three women in New South Wales on Saturday.Sergei Mitnik did not apply for release on Sunday when he appeared in a bail court hours after being charged with the murder of an elderly woman inside a unit at Sydney’s Bondi Beach.
